title: Поцелуй на прощание и примирение семьи  (A Goodnight Kiss and Family Reconciliation)

segments.t: Walking Elena to her door, Viktor Petrovich fumbles for words until Elena gently teases him and gives him a warm goodnight kiss. Back at the apartment, meanwhile, Kostya and Nastya's father return from the stairwell happily reconciled after secretly polished off cognac and sausage together.

'No, I do not want to right now.' The negative particle sits right before the verb meaning 'there is no' to negate the statement. Kostya answers right away.
'Then what do you want right now?' Kostya anchors the line on 'and', while 'you want' completes the thought.
'Goodness, you head chefs seem like such tough guys.' The grammar packs 'good Lord!' and 'kids' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange.
'So why are you so silly sometimes?' Notice how Russian expresses 'why' and 'foolish' with crisp inflection rather than helper words. Kostya answers right away.

'No, I will write it down right now.' Notice how Russian expresses 'there is no' and 'will write' with crisp inflection rather than helper words. Kostya answers right away.
'You need the letter K.' The meaning hinges on 'you' working together with 'needs to be' in spoken Russian.
'Dad, are you not ashamed of yourself?' In Russian, the idea of 'Dad' flows naturally into 'ashamed' without extra filler words.
'In that case, I am heading home.' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'then' before landing on 'am leaving'. Kostya answers right away.
'Well, the animal may have been poor.' The grammar packs 'come on' and 'poor' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange.
